title: Figures 23-24: Cylinder CFD contours, pressure and temperature at 1500 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of a flat-ended cylinder at 1/6 scale used as a comparison shape, each with a pressure color legend in Pa. Captions read "Figure 23. Cylinder Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 1500 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" and "Figure 24. Cylinder Temperature at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 1500 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet"; both images show a bow shock ahead of the blunt front face. Page 45 of the BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report.
